description: Query specification for tools/fetch-prices.py. Every query is an OData $filter against https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices (server side) plus optional include/exclude regular expressions (client side), run once per currency. Regions: eu = West Europe, Sweden Central, North Europe; global = armRegionName 'Global' or '' (the API uses both for region-less meters). Written 2026-10-31.

queries.topic: API Management, every tier per unit-hour (Consumption, Developer, Basic, Standard, Premium, v2 tiers, workspace gateways)
Container Apps: Consumption (active/idle vCPU and memory, requests), dedicated plans, dynamic sessions, environment. Jobs use the same meters. The monthly free grant is not in the API (see manual).
Functions: Flex Consumption (on-demand, always-ready), Consumption, Premium
Cosmos DB: serverless, provisioned (standard, multi-region write, autoscale), storage, free tier, backup, analytical store, 100 RU/s reservations

include.productName: ^Azure Cosmos DB( serverless| autoscale| - PITR| Analytics Storage| Snapshot| Data Transfer)?$

queries.topic: PostgreSQL flexible server: burstable and general purpose compute, storage, backup, HorizonDB

include.productName: Flexible Server (Burstable BS Series Compute|General Purpose Ddsv5 Series Compute|Backup Storage)|Flex Server Storage|Azure HorizonDB

queries.topic: Azure SQL Database: serverless (General Purpose, Gen5, with the free-offer meters), free offer, DTU Basic/Standard, General Purpose storage and PITR backup

include.productName: ^SQL Database (General Purpose - Serverless - Compute Gen5|Single Free|Single Basic|Single Standard|Single/Elastic Pool General Purpose - Storage|Single/Elastic Pool PITR Backup Storage)$

queries.topic: Azure SQL Database provisioned General Purpose Gen5, 2 and 4 vCores (comparison with serverless)
queries.filter: serviceName eq 'SQL Database' and productName eq 'SQL Database Single/Elastic Pool General Purpose - Compute Gen5'

queries.topic: Azure AI Search (service name in the API: Azure Cognitive Search): Free, Basic, S1-S3, L1-L2, semantic ranker, agentic retrieval, serverless, skills
Blob Storage (general-purpose v2 and ADLS Gen2): hot, cool, cold, archive; LRS and ZRS; capacity, operations, retrieval, early delete
queries.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and (productName eq 'General Block Blob v2' or productName eq 'General Block Blob v2 Hierarchical Namespace')

include.meterName: Data Stored|Write Operations|Read Operations|All Other Operations|List and Create Container Operations|Data Retrieval|Early Delete
